instructions.bs: Poslanik ﷺ tražio je oprost od Allaha i kajao Mu se više od 70 puta dnevno.
instructions.en: The Prophet ﷺ sought Allah’s forgiveness and turned to Him in repentance more than 70 times a day.

translation.bs: Od Allaha tražim oprost i Njemu se kajem.
translation.en: I seek Allah’s forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance.

sayings.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ

instructions.bs: Onome ko izgovori ovaj zikr Allah će oprostiti čak i ako je utekao sa bojnoga polja.
instructions.en: Whoever says this will be forgiven, even if they fled from the battlefield.

transcription.bs: Estagfirullāhe-l-leḏī lā ilāhe illā Huve-l-Ḥajju-l-Qajjūmu ve etūbu ilejhi.
transcription.en: Astaghfirullāha alladhī lā ilāha illā huwal-Ḥayyul-Qayyūmu wa atūbu ilayh.

translation.bs: Tražim oprosta od Allaha, osim Kojega drugoga boga nema, Živog i Postojanog Održavatelja, i Njemu se kajem.
translation.en: I seek forgiveness from Allah, besides Whom none is worthy of worship, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I turn to Him in repentance.

title.bs: Zikr za slavljenje Allaha i zahvalu
title.en: Dhikr for glorifying and praising Allah

instructions.bs: Proučiti ovo 100 puta dnevno. U hadisu se navodi oprost grijeha, makar ih bilo poput morske pjene.
instructions.en: This is recited 100 times a day. The hadith describes forgiveness of sins, even if they are as abundant as sea foam.

translation.bs: Neka je slavljen Allah i neka Mu je hvala.
translation.en: Glory be to Allah, and all praise is His.

instructions.bs: Proučiti ovo 100 puta dnevno. U hadisu se navodi da se za to upisuje 1.000 dobrih djela ili briše 1.000 grijeha.
instructions.en: This is recited 100 times a day. The hadith describes 1,000 good deeds being recorded or 1,000 sins being erased.

translation.bs: Neka je slavljen Allah i neka Mu je hvala.

sayings.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

instructions.bs: Proučiti ovo 100 puta dnevno. U hadisu se navode nagrada kao za oslobađanje 10 robova, upisivanje 100 dobrih djela, brisanje 100 grijeha i zaštita od šejtana do večeri.
instructions.en: This is recited 100 times a day. The hadith mentions a reward equivalent to freeing 10 slaves, 100 good deeds recorded, 100 sins erased, and protection from Satan until evening.

transcription.bs: Lā ilāhe illellāhu vaḥdehū lā šerīke leh, lehu-l-mulku ve lehu-l-ḥamdu ve Huve ‘alā kulli šej’in Qadīr.
transcription.en: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, wa huwa ‘alā kulli shay’in qadīr.

translation.bs: Nema boga osim Allaha, Jedinoga, Koji Sebi ravnoga nema. Njemu pripada sva vlast i zahvalnost, i On je iznad svega.
translation.en: None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is all dominion and praise, and He has power over everything.

title.en: Dhikr beloved to the Most Merciful

sayings.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ

instructions.bs: Ove dvije riječi su lahke na jeziku, teške na Vagi i drage Svemilosnom.
instructions.en: These two phrases are easy to say, heavy on the Scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful.

translation.bs: Slavljen neka je Allah i hvaljen neka je. Slavljen da si Uzvišeni Allahu.
translation.en: Glory and praise be to Allah. Glory be to Allah, the Most Great.

title.en: Four words most beloved to Allah

sayings.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

instructions.bs: Ove četiri riječi Allahu su najdraže i može se početi bilo kojom od njih. Poslaniku ﷺ bile su draže od svega što sunce obasja.
instructions.en: These four phrases are the words most beloved to Allah, and recitation may begin with any of them. The Prophet ﷺ said they were dearer to him than everything the sun shines upon.

transcription.bs: Subḥānallāhi ve-l-ḥamdu lillāhi ve lā ilāhe illellāhu vallāhu ekber.
transcription.en: Subḥānallāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh, wa lā ilāha illallāh, wallāhu akbar.

translation.bs: Slavljen neka je Allah i hvala Mu, nema boga osim Allaha, Allah je najveći.
translation.en: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Allah. None is worthy of worship except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.

title.en: Dhikr for glorifying Allah, the Most Great

instructions.bs: U predaji se navodi da će onome ko izgovori ove riječi u Džennetu biti zasađena palma.
instructions.en: The narration mentions a date palm being planted in Paradise for whoever says these words.

translation.bs: Slavljen neka je Uzvišeni Allah i neka Mu je hvala.
translation.en: Glory and praise be to Allah, the Most Great.

title.en: A dhikr from the treasures of Paradise

sayings.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ

instructions.bs: Poslanik ﷺ nazvao je ove riječi jednom od džennetskih riznica.
instructions.en: The Prophet ﷺ described these words as one of the treasures of Paradise.

transcription.bs: Lā ḥavle ve lā quvvete illā billāhi.
transcription.en: Lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.

translation.bs: Nema snage niti moći mimo Allaha.
translation.en: There is no strength or power except through Allah.

instructions.bs: U predaji se ove riječi navode kao najbolja dova.
instructions.en: The narration describes these words as the best supplication.

instructions.bs: U predaji se ove riječi navode kao najbolji spomen Allaha.
instructions.en: The narration describes these words as the best remembrance of Allah.

translation.en: None is worthy of worship except Allah.

sayings.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ

transcription.bs: Subḥānallāhi ve-l-ḥamdu lillāhi ve lā ilāhe illallāhu, vallāhu ekber, ve lā ḥavle ve lā quvvete illā billāh.
transcription.en: Subḥānallāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh, wa lā ilāha illallāh, wallāhu akbar, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.

translation.bs: Neka je slavljen Allah, i neka Mu je hvala. Nema boga osim Allaha i On je najveći. Nema snage niti moći mimo Allaha.
translation.en: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Allah. None is worthy of worship except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. There is no strength or power except through Allah.
